settings_intro: Manage every AI feature centrally. Changes require justification and are enforced by the server.
settings_inactive: Server-side AI configuration is inactive. Switches may be saved, but AI cannot run until the server key and emergency switch are configured.
settings_server_available: Server AI integration is available. The master and individual feature switches still apply.
settings_server_incomplete: Server setup is incomplete. Enablement will not allow AI requests until the server is configured.
budget_unlimited_hint: No monthly limit is set. Each person can still make 12 requests an hour and 40 a day.
budget_migration: Apply migration 17 to enable the monthly budget.
budget_no_requests: No AI requests yet this month.
settings_footnote: Only Super Admin can change these settings. A server-side emergency disable always takes precedence.
approval_explain: This affects all users. The change takes effect on the next AI request and will be recorded in the audit log.
approval_reason_placeholder: Briefly explain why you are changing this setting
budget_modal_info: Applies to the whole company. When the month’s tokens are used up, AI pauses until the 1st of next month or until you raise the budget.
budget_reason_example: For example: October OpenAI credit is limited
budget_resets: Resets on {{date}}. AI pauses when the budget is used up.
budget_removed_success: Monthly budget removed. AI use is limited only by the per-person limits.
feature_group_platform_info: Turns off every feature that uses OpenAI. Features marked "No tokens" keep working.
feature_group_available_info: Switch each feature on only if your budget allows it.
feature_group_planned_info: These switches unlock as each feature is released. They start off.
error_save: Unable to save. Please try again.
feature_master_description: Master switch for every AI feature that uses OpenAI. Features that run inside AppraisalSuite keep working.
feature_assistant_description: Answers questions and looks up appraisals each person is allowed to see.
feature_ask_panel_description: An Ask AI button in the top bar that opens the Assistant beside any page.
feature_management_insights_description: Turns cycle statistics into observations and actions. Results are saved and reused.
feature_writing_assistant_description: Helps supervisors and staff turn notes into clear comments and feedback.
feature_development_plan_description: Drafts a development objective, actions and review measures.
feature_setup_assistant_description: Suggests wording when creating cycles, sections, KPI and general questions.
feature_rankings_description: Ranks departments, supervisors and levels, and compares ratings with the guideline spread. Also lets the Assistant answer "which department scored highest".
feature_calibration_description: Shows supervisors who rate much higher or lower than the company average.
feature_alerts_description: Flags big score drops, people rated Outstanding three years running, and scores below Fully Meets.
feature_progress_description: Shows who still needs a level, objectives, an appraisal or an acknowledgement. Supervisors see their own team.
feature_smart_search_description: Lets the top search bar understand requests like "pending acknowledgements in Procurement".
feature_fairness_check_description: Before an appraisal is submitted, flags missing evidence, identical ratings and recommendations that do not fit the score. The rule checks are free; the optional AI wording check uses tokens.
feature_cycle_briefing_description: A one-page management briefing for a cycle, written from the Analytics figures. Saved, so reopening it is free.
feature_feedback_summary_description: Groups what employees wrote when acknowledging into themes and flags disagreements. Names are not sent to OpenAI.
feature_explain_appraisal_description: A plain-language explanation of an appraisal result for the employee or reviewer. Saved per version.
feature_reminder_drafts_description: Drafts reminder emails from the Progress tracker, ready to send from Send Email.
feature_kpi_suggestions_description: Suggests measurable targets and evidence inside the objective plan.
suggest_staff_ack: How do I acknowledge my appraisal?
suggest_staff_followup: What happens when management requests a follow-up?
suggest_supervisor_objectives: How do I set and lock objectives?
suggest_admin_safety: How does management verify a serious safety breach?
suggest_superadmin_company: List appraisals in my selected company
suggest_superadmin_caps: Explain score caps and management verification
assistant_error: The assistant could not respond. Please try again.
assistant_history_privacy: Private to you in this company.
assistant_readonly: Read-only. Uses only records you can access.
assistant_disabled: AI Assistant is currently unavailable. Contact your Super Admin to check AI settings and server configuration.
assistant_choose_company: Select a company from View Context to use saved conversations.
assistant_welcome_detail: I can explain the appraisal process or retrieve existing appraisal records you're permitted to see.
assistant_ask_placeholder: Ask about appraisals, scores or how the process works
assistant_keyhint: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line
assistant_disclaimer: Reads existing records only. It cannot change appraisals or make decisions.
panel_suggest_view_score: How was the overall score for appraisal {{id}} worked out?
panel_suggest_view_ack: What happens after an appraisal is acknowledged?
panel_suggest_mine_years: Show my appraisal scores for the last 3 years
panel_suggest_rating: What does each rating from 1 to 5 mean?
panel_suggest_team_year: Show my team’s appraisals for this year
panel_suggest_team_ack: Which of my team’s appraisals are awaiting acknowledgement?
panel_suggest_ack_count: How many appraisals this year are awaiting acknowledgement?
panel_suggest_year_access: Show this year’s appraisals I can access
panel_suggest_staff_update: What happens when my appraisal is updated?
panel_suggest_integrity: Explain the safety and integrity score cap
panel_need_company: Select a company in View Context to ask about its appraisals.
panel_budget_reached: This month’s AI budget has been used up. The Super Admin can raise it in AI Settings.
panel_disabled: The AI Assistant is switched off at the moment.
panel_welcome: What would you like to know?
panel_welcome_detail: Ask about appraisals, scores or how the process works. Answers are saved to your AI Assistant history.
setup_description: Tell AI what you're trying to achieve before it suggests a structure.
setup_advice: Draft guidance only. Existing cycle rules, weights and question approvals remain under your control.
setup_unavailable: Setup Assistant is unavailable. Ask your Super Admin to enable it and check server AI configuration.
setup_intent: What do you want to achieve?
setup_intent_hint: Describe the team, purpose, expected behaviours or measurable outcomes. Avoid employee names and personal details.
setup_constraints_hint: E.g. cycle period, intended categories, approval rules or measurement guidance to consider.
setup_clipboard_error: Clipboard is unavailable. Select and copy the guidance manually.
explain_info: A plain-language reading of the scores and comments. It does not change anything.
explain_unavailable: AI is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
explain_meta: Written by AI {{date}} for this version. {{note}}
explain_own_note: Talk to your supervisor if anything is unclear.
explain_other_note: Check it against the appraisal before sharing.
explain_error: The explanation could not be written. Please try again.
feature_content_translation_description: Translate authorised appraisal feedback and management notes on request; originals are preserved and cached results reuse no AI tokens.
